Keep failed retries latched without successful-compaction accounting. Forward configured engines to native model harnesses and share admitted byte budgets across core/SDK module copies so Codex follows the bounded projection instead of retaining oversized native context. Fixes #165460 Related: #166665 * fix: preserve dispatch without a host context engine

Document intentional maintenance isolation in the request-census fixtures. * test: isolate pending-final writer boundary from verbosity refresh * test(sessions): align delivery fixtures with fixed patch operations Use the canonical reducer for the in-memory dispatch store and inject recovery failures at durable settlement. Preserve the existing ownership, audit, media, and pending-final assertions. Both repaired suites pass all 304 cases. * test(reply): restore fixed session writes in SQLite completion fixture
